class.name: LexicalTagBackend
class.brief_description: Semantic search backend backed by the lexical asset tag index.
class.description: Delegates search, similarity, rebuild, and stats calls to [SemanticAssetIndex]. This is the default lightweight backend when embedding providers are not required.

method.name: find_similar
method.description: Returns up to [param limit] assets similar to the indexed asset at [param path].

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the lexical index via [method SemanticAssetIndex.rebuild_index]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the index is unavailable.

method.name: search
method.description: Searches indexed assets for [param query] and returns up to [param limit] matches.
